description:
Blockfall is the falling-block puzzle you already know how to play, rebuilt to feel perfect on iPhone. Seven glossy pieces, a 10x20 well, and one simple goal: keep the stack low and the lines clearing.

Drag anywhere to slide a piece, tap to rotate, flick down to slam it home, or use the chunky on-screen buttons. A ghost piece shows exactly where you'll land, the Hold slot saves a piece for later, and the Next queue lets you plan four moves ahead. Modern wall kicks, lock delay and a fair 7-bag randomiser mean every game is won or lost on skill.

Chain combos, land back-to-back four-line Blockfalls, and climb the levels as the speed ramps up. Pick your starting level, chase your best score, and see how long you can survive.
whatsNew: Smoother drag controls, a brighter ghost piece, and new line-clear sparkles. Thanks for playing!
